cards.text: It's the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, king of Persia (Ezra 4:24). God's people are back at work on the LORD's temple (Haggai 1:14). And the word of the LORD comes to Haggai the prophet once again.
This time the LORD of Hosts opens with a question. Haggai has to go get an official ruling on it. Not a guess, not a hunch, a RULING.

cards.question: Who does the LORD of Hosts tell Haggai to ask for a ruling?

cards.text: Here's the question, and it's a good one. A man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and it touches bread, stew, wine, oil or any other food.

cards.question: Consecrated meat in a man's garment touches other food. True or false: the priests rule that the food becomes holy.

cards.text: So holy doesn't rub off on the food. Then Haggai flips the question and asks about someone defiled by contact with a corpse.

cards.question: If someone defiled by contact with a corpse touches that food, the priests rule that it becomes ___.

cards.text: Then Haggai brings it home, speaking for the LORD: "So it is with this people and this nation before Me". Holy doesn't rub off but defiled does, which is me with dough in my mustache, because ONE swipe and the whole bakery is covered.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says whatever this people offers there is holy.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells them to "consider carefully from this day forward" and has them look back.

cards.question: The LORD has the people look back to a time. Before what?

answers.text: Before one stone was placed on another
Before they came out of Egypt

cards.question: Back then, the harvest came up short. Someone came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain and found only ___.

cards.text: Same story at the winepress: they came to draw out fifty baths and got twenty. That's like opening a box marked two dozen cookies and finding twelve, and friend, I would be writing a LETTER.

cards.question: The LORD says He struck all the work of their hands with blight, mildew and hail. What does He say the people did?

answers.text: They did not turn to Him

cards.text: Blight, mildew, hail. That's three alarms, and they hit snooze on all three. Then comes that line again, "consider carefully from this day forward," and this time God names the day: the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month.

cards.question: God names the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the same day this message came to Haggai. What happened on that day?

answers.text: The foundation of the LORD's temple was laid
The LORD's temple was finished at last
The ark was brought into the temple

cards.text: Then the LORD asks a question I've asked about my own cookie jar: "Is there still seed in the barn?"

cards.question: True or false: the vine, the fig, the pomegranate and the olive tree have already yielded fruit.
The trees haven't yielded fruit yet. But from this day on, God says He will ___ them.
